verdict.rationale: Puzzle has a dedicated 'AI Close' feature and Accounting AI for PDF/CSV import, batch categorization, custom rules, and auto-categorization (up to 98%), plus explicit 'AI Close Agents' branding, which together map closely to matching transactions, flagging exceptions, and preparing close for review. However, there is no first-party documentation detailing an end-to-end autonomous month-close workflow (exception flagging logic, human-review handoff mechanics) beyond marketing claims, and no independent/hands-on verification of the AI Close agent's reliability. Missing for 10: detailed workflow docs on exception handling and human review handoff, independent verification of AI Close accuracy/reliability, hands-on user reports of full month-end close automation.
